---
name: Bug report
about: Something wrong with SHORK, included software or features
title: Bug with *SHORK/feature*
labels: bug, enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Scenario**
Please describe the issue you experienced and what you were doing when you experienced it. Please include screenshots, photos or logs of any error messages relating to the issue.

**Expected behaviour**
If the issue was something else happening rather than an outright crash, please describe what you expected to happen when you experienced the issue.

**Reproducing**
Please outline how one may recreate the scenario. For example, what to run and/or press to get to where you experienced the issue.

**SHORK version**
Please state the version of SHORK (486/DISC/DISKETTE) you are running, and if SHORK 486, its build type (Mini/Default/Plus/etc.) Even better, you can attach your after-build report (`images/report.txt`).

**Hardware**
Please list your device name, CPU, RAM, swap (if present) and free disk space. If networking-related, please also include details of your networking hardware. If running in a virtual machine, please provide its configuration.

**Additional context**
Anything else you think is relevant or helpful.
